intro.titleStart: FLUX, the schedule that works for
intro.text: Pick your days and your rhythm. Flux sets up the slots your clients can book from your storefront.
intro.shortcutText: I've already set my business hours

days.titleStart: Which days do you want to make
days.subtitle: Select every day your clients can book an appointment.

rhythm.subtitle: This rhythm will apply to the selected days. You can fine-tune it later in your schedule.

variable.subtitle: Keep the main rhythm or adjust each day. No fields to fill in.

review.title: Here are the slots offered to your clients.

tunnel.successToast: Your hours are set. Your schedule is open at the right times.

empty.title: First, your storefront
empty.text: Your schedule activates as soon as your page exists: your clients book directly from it.

view.noUpcoming: Your week is quiet. Your slots stay open and your storefront keeps working for you.
view.upcomingCount: {count} upcoming appointments. Everything's ready to welcome your clients.
view.weekHint: Tap a day to see your schedule. The red dot = appointments.
view.clientsHint: This list fills itself in with every booking. Tap a client to see their history and your private note.
view.firstClientHint: Your first client will appear here after their booking.
view.variableHoursHint: Each day can have its own rhythm. Hover over a row to bring it to the front.
view.variableHoursSaved: Saved. Your clients already see the right slots.
view.blockPeriodHint: Time off, personal appointments: no one will be able to book over it.
view.googleAgendaHint: Paste this link ONCE into Google Calendar (+ → "From URL") and your appointments show up there automatically. Read-only — keep it to yourself.

errors.not_authenticated: You need to be logged in to continue.
errors.end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
